Full video at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgtqXyP5IGk ~ In 1990, Japanese law forced arcade makers to include backup games inside cabinets; in case the main one was banned. Hidden menus, secret titles, and ghost code filled arcades across Japan.
